evidence: estate_loop_unattended_* (crates/susi-daemon/src/tests/estate_loop_unattended.rs — 7 tests: an unattended pass observes the estate, diffs it against DesiredState and plans every action kind — warm an undeclared model, collect undeclared resident weights, start a stopped declared runtime, drain an up undeclared one, rotate away from a cooled provider — with every act driven through the injected actuator seam; foreign listeners and operator-held services are never touched; a pass that dies mid-flight resumes from the durable journal rather than restarting — applied actions are never re-taken and the pass completes once; a failed act is recorded and not retried within the pass; policy holds (estate.hold, an act allowlist that omits a kind, autonomy report) never actuate but are still recorded and audited; every pass and every act is signed into the audit chain which verifies; a missing desired-state document plans nothing and still journals the pass; the production wiring is pinned by source scan — Maintenance::tick invokes estate_loop::run_pass and run_pass calls observe(), plan() and ProductionActuator, which actuates through service_table, the native model substrate and provider cooldown seams). estate_autonomy_tiers_* (crates/susi-daemon/src/tests/estate_autonomy_tiers.rs — 7 tests: blast-radius tiering — low-blast acts are automatic while drain/rotate ask by default; a one-shot durable grant under estate-approvals/ is consumed before actuation so a crash never re-runs a costly change and never carries over to the next pass; dry_run rehearses every act without touching the seam; the awaiting receipt names the grant file an operator writes; an explicit hold beats a grant and report holds everything; a refused approved act re-arms its grant rather than burning it; tier wiring pinned by source scan). estate_operations_capability_floor_* (crates/susi-gemi/src/tests/estate_operations_capability_floor.rs — 6 tests: TaskClass::EstateOps declares a Reasoning floor as data beside the class; the requires:"estate"/"estate_ops" dispatch token maps into it and prompt text never classifies in by accident; under the frugal dial the cheapest below-floor model still cannot lead an estate-ops ranking while the below-floor rung is kept as last resort, never dropped; cost still decides between floor-meeting candidates; the class is a row in the leaders table the scout publishes rather than a special case; the floor, token mapping and cost profile are pinned on the shared ladder — no parallel estate-only ranking).
